item.summary: The Bitcoin Fund ETF (BBIT) began trading on SIX Swiss Exchange on 26 November 2026 in Swiss francs and US dollars. Pernet von Ballmoos AG is the fund management company, BIT Asset Management is the sponsor and manager, and Flow Traders is the market maker. The fund holds physical bitcoin in segregated cold storage and is subject to the Swiss Collective Investment Schemes Act (CISA); BIT Asset Management states a total expense ratio of 0.19% a year.
